verdict.rationale: AgentMail explicitly documents IMAP/SMTP connectivity so any standard mail client (Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail) can access inboxes, directly supporting openness and switcher portability. However, there's no mention of JMAP support or a dedicated standards-based bulk export/backup feature (e.g., mbox/eml export), so full protocol-and-format portability isn't fully evidenced. Missing for 10: JMAP protocol support, documented data export/backup format, independent confirmation that IMAP/SMTP works reliably in practice.
